controls.label: Fan step
controls.serializedMeaning: Angular displacement produced by one whole source-index distance from fractional focus.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed focus, outer card angles and lateral spread change while pivot, crown identity, source ratio, and story time remain unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines the hand's temporal spatial grammar; it is neither Frame nor Timeline.

controls.label: Pivot depth
controls.unit: percent of canvas height below bottom
controls.serializedMeaning: Vertical location of the common radial pivot below the stage.
controls.causalObservation: All card bottom-centre arcs steepen or flatten coherently; crown identity and source order do not change.
controls.ownershipReason: The below-stage pivot is essential Scene physics.

controls.label: Visible window
controls.serializedMeaning: Maximum odd count of mounted source identities nearest fractional focus.
controls.causalObservation: Mounted neighbour count and guard-zone extent change without changing focus, order, or any mounted card's canonical path.
controls.ownershipReason: Controls bounded hand context and virtualization, unique to this Scene.

controls.label: Presentation lift
controls.serializedMeaning: Maximum radial crown lift applied by the smooth focus kernel.
controls.causalObservation: Only near-crown bottom-centre distance, scale, and depth promotion change; angular focus and card order remain fixed.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Source card width before ratio and portrait collision adaptation.
controls.causalObservation: Card widths/heights and collision pressure change while pivot path and focus timing remain unchanged.
controls.ownershipReason: Determines Scene composition density; global Frame fit remains separate.
